checklist_adapter.reviewed_at: ISO8601 timestamp with timezone; no generated default
checklist_adapter.review_method: Explicit per-row review_method column or CLI flag; no human default; automatic methods not accepted
checklist_adapter.image_model_assisted: Actual review_model column or --review-model model/revision/service version required; actual reviewer retained; never labelled human
checklist_adapter.traceability: Original checklist/mechanical CSV/full source package SHA; B-derived review ID; original six-field record, source line and basis bytes retained outside prompts
checklist_adapter.blank_or_unknown: Diagnostic-only, no formal subset; actual S3 remains unaccepted until actual media and reviews validated
checklist_adapter.source_immutable: No finalizer invocation, checklist bytes never rewritten
checklist_adapter.new_A_S3_fields: retrieval_rank=null; positional rank preserved; finalized image digest checked separately from full metadata/review digest
checklist_adapter.authority: Explicit selected checklist revision or default package review_checklist.csv; supplemental confirmation cannot override blank/supports/unknown/incomplete verdicts. Bound source_checklist_sha256 required; reviewer/time/method/basis/media must agree.
checklist_adapter.revision_trace: Original package checklist SHA and active selected checklist origin retained; raw CSV and derived JSON runtime-bound; no source rewrite
